subject: Azure solution catalog connector — architecture & ops workshop scheduling
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya@azurepartner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alan Cheng <alan.cheng@azurepartner.com>, CloudOps Team <cloudops@azurepartner.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure solution catalog connector — architecture & ops workshop scheduling

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for proposing this workshop. Our engineering and CloudOps leads would like a focused 90-minute session that covers:
- connector authentication patterns and KMS integration
- marketplace catalog metadata mapping and sync cadence
- ops/runbook items for rollout (monitoring, alerts, fallback)

Preferable windows next week (PST): Wed 10/7 10:00–11:30 or Thu 10/8 14:00–15:30. We also have a strict blackout on Fri afternoon for an internal release.

I attached a short design sketch and our mapping table to this thread (azure_connector_design.pdf) — helps steer the discussion.

Would Marissa/your infra lead be able to cover the runtime configuration and KV cache expectations? Alan will bring the marketplace onboarding checklist.

Cheers,
Priya
Principal Solutions Architect
Azure Partner Solutions

--
Attachment: azure_connector_design.pdf (application/pdf, 820 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya@azurepartner.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure solution catalog connector — architecture & ops workshop scheduling

Thanks Priya — this is perfect context.

Sergio and Jonas: can you confirm availability for the two windows Priya suggested? Our plan is a 90-minute joint workshop broken into: 30 min architecture alignment, 30 min interactive runbook/ops scenarios, 30 min action items & next steps.

I also uploaded a brief Redwood pre-work checklist and a short agenda to a shared Drive folder (link below). If you can skim the checklist beforehand, we can use the time to focus on decisions.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-project-folder
Prework: redwood_prework-checklist.md (attached)

If we can lock Wed 10/7 10:00 PST I’ll send a calendar invite and include a Teams / Zoom option.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Partner Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: redwood_prework-checklist.md (text/markdown, 4 KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Menon <priya@azurepartner.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure solution catalog connector — architecture & ops workshop scheduling

Marissa/Priya —

I’m available Wed 10/7 10:00–11:30 PST. Jonas is out of office Wed morning but can join by phone for the tail end; he can cover the runtime kernel/quantization questions in the document. Quick note for the agenda: we should block ~10 minutes for SLA/capacity expectations — specifically dedicated vs hosted fallback behavior when catalog sync spikes.

Also, can the Azure team share the expected max payload size and expected rate of metadata updates? That will inform batch sizing and KV cache TTL recommendations.

Sergio
Staff Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Menon <priya@azurepartner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alan Cheng <alan.cheng@azurepartner.com>, CloudOps Team <cloudops@azurepartner.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure solution catalog connector — architecture & ops workshop scheduling

Great — Wed 10/7 10:00 PST works for us. One small ask: Alan has a calendar conflict and asked whether we could move to Thu 10/8 09:00–10:30 PST instead. Our preference is Thu morning, but if that won't work for Redwood we can keep Wed.

We can provide preliminary answers to the payload/rate questions in a short doc tomorrow — I’ll drop it into the Drive folder.

Best,
Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya@azurepartner.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Alan Cheng <alan.cheng@azurepartner.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure solution catalog connector — architecture & ops workshop scheduling

Thanks everyone — appreciate the flexibility. 

We’ll move the workshop to Thu 10/8 09:00–10:30 PST to accommodate Alan. Calendar invite sent (includes Zoom link + placeholder agenda). Agenda highlights:
- 09:00–09:25 Architecture & auth patterns (Marissa + Jonas)
- 09:25–09:55 Ops/runbook scenarios & monitoring (Sergio + Priya)
- 09:55–10:20 Data mapping/cleanup & marketplace metadata cadence (Alan)
- 10:20–10:30 Action items & next steps (all)

Pre-work: please review redwood_prework-checklist.md and the design sketch Priya attached. If you have any specific integration constraints (network egress, KMS policies), drop them in the Drive doc before EOD Wed so we can include them in the Ops section.

See you Thu —
Marissa
Partner Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

--
